skill.name: hugging-face-jobs
skill.description: Prepare, submit, monitor, schedule, and persist machine learning workloads on Hugging Face Jobs using managed CPU, GPU, and TPU resources.
skill.summary: Run reproducible Hugging Face cloud workloads with suitable compute, authentication, monitoring, and Hub persistence.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are detector noise from Markdown, documentation URLs, safe environment access, and ordinary API examples. Confirmed risks involve exposed tokens and mutable remote code; semantic review also found unpinned images and missing approval gates for paid jobs.

remediation.issue: Mutable remote scripts are executed without integrity controls.
remediation.suggestion: Pin every remote script to an immutable commit and verify its digest before submission. Prefer the bundled reviewed script content.

remediation.issue: Mutable container images can run while HF_TOKEN is available.
remediation.suggestion: Pin container images by digest and review the image provenance. Never pass credentials to an unpinned image.

remediation.issue: Token command substitution and command-line options can expose credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Remove hf-token arguments and shell substitution examples. Use the platform secret option or an authenticated credential store.

remediation.issue: Paid and recurring jobs can be created without final user confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Show hardware, timeout, destination, schedule, and estimated cost. Require explicit approval immediately before every submission or schedule creation.

semantic_findings.title: Paid Job Submission Has No Confirmation Gate
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs the agent to submit paid jobs before reporting cost details and also supports recurring schedules. It does not require final user approval before creating either workload.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The directive explicitly submits first and reports details afterward, while the documented examples show nonzero costs and recurring jobs.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Container Images Receive Credentials
semantic_findings.description: Examples run mutable latest or implicit-latest container images. One command passes HF_TOKEN into that image, allowing a compromised future image to capture the credential.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The image references are visibly unpinned, and the script example places HF_TOKEN in the same container invocation.

semantic_findings.title: Secrets Accepted Through Command-Line Arguments
semantic_findings.description: All bundled scripts accept Hugging Face tokens as command-line values. Tokens supplied this way can remain in shell history or appear in process listings.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Each parser explicitly defines an hf-token option, a well-known credential exposure channel when users supply the value on a command line.

content.value_statement: Large machine learning workloads need costly hardware and reliable persistence. This skill prepares Hugging Face Jobs with suitable compute, secrets, schedules, and Hub storage.
actual_capabilities: Prepares inline UV or Docker job submissions for CPU, GPU, and TPU workloads.
Selects documented hardware flavors and timeouts for different workload sizes.
Passes Hugging Face authentication through job secrets for Hub operations.
Lists jobs, inspects status, retrieves logs, and cancels active workloads.
Creates scheduled jobs and explains webhook-triggered workflows.
Provides scripts for batch generation, synthetic data, and streaming dataset statistics.
limitations: Hugging Face Jobs requires an eligible paid account and valid authentication.
Remote workloads can incur charges and depend on external hardware availability.
Bundled scripts expect specific models, datasets, dependencies, and output schemas.
The skill cannot guarantee runtime, final cost, model quality, or service availability.

use_cases.title: Process Large Datasets
use_cases.description: Prepare a managed CPU job that transforms data and persists results to a selected Hub repository.

use_cases.title: Run Batch Model Inference
use_cases.description: Configure a GPU job that generates responses for a Hub dataset and publishes the completed dataset.

use_cases.title: Automate Recurring Workloads
use_cases.description: Create reviewed schedules for periodic processing, monitoring, and Hub updates.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a CPU Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Hugging Face Job for [task] on cpu-basic. Estimate runtime and cost, then wait for my approval before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation of a small workload

prompt_templates.title: Configure Batch Inference
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare batch inference for dataset [dataset] with model [model]. Recommend hardware, timeout, output repository, and a secure token configuration.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate GPU inference over a Hub dataset

prompt_templates.title: Design a Scheduled Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a scheduled job for [task] using schedule [schedule]. Show expected cost, persistence, failure handling, and approval details before creation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced recurring data or inference workflow

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Reproducible Multi-GPU Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a multi-GPU job for [workload]. Pin scripts and images, set least-privilege secrets, add checkpoints, and define monitoring and cancellation criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert production workload with supply-chain controls

output_examples.input: Prepare a small sentiment-analysis test on managed CPU.
output: Persistence: Save the result to the named Hub dataset

output_examples.input: Run batch inference on a private dataset with an eight-billion-parameter model.
output: Hardware: Start with one A10G GPU and validate a small sample
Authentication: Use a read token for input and write access only for the output repository
Safety: Pin the model, script, dependencies, and container image

output_examples.input: Create a daily dataset statistics job.
output: Schedule: Daily at the approved UTC time
Output: Versioned statistics in the selected Hub repository
Control: Confirm estimated monthly cost before schedule creation

best_practices: Pin remote scripts, dependencies, models, and container images to immutable versions.
Confirm hardware, timeout, schedule, destination, and estimated cost before submission.
Use least-privilege secrets and persist required outputs before the job ends.
anti_patterns: Do not place access tokens in scripts, environment examples, shell substitutions, or command arguments.
Do not execute scripts or images from mutable branches and tags.
Do not submit paid or recurring jobs before the user approves the final configuration.

faq.question: Do I need a paid Hugging Face account?
faq.answer: Yes. Hugging Face Jobs requires an eligible Pro, Team, or Enterprise account.

faq.question: Can this skill use GPUs and TPUs?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents available CPU, GPU, and TPU flavors and helps select a suitable option.

faq.question: How are results preserved?
faq.answer: Jobs are temporary. Persist required outputs to the Hugging Face Hub or another approved external store.

faq.question: How should authentication be provided?
faq.answer: Use the platform secret mechanism with a least-privilege token. Avoid command-line values and ordinary environment configuration.

faq.question: Can the skill create scheduled jobs?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports predefined schedules and cron expressions, but recurring cost requires explicit approval.

faq.question: Does the skill monitor jobs continuously?
faq.answer: No. It provides status, inspection, log, and cancellation operations without continuous polling.
